div.div:
• Admin → every zone, Gateway, WAN: any
• VPN → Admin, Mgmt, Core, Servers, Storage, IoT, User: any · VPN → Guest: blocked
• Every zone → Core: DNS 53 to the filtering resolvers (10.110.0.12/.13) only
• Every zone → WAN: any, after anti-leak blocks (53, 853, public DoH on 443)
• Mgmt → Storage: pve → PBS 8007
• Core → Servers: git 443 to Traefik · Core → WAN: DoT 853 to Quad9 (filtering resolvers only)
• Servers → Core: Traefik → Pi-hole 80 / Technitium 5380, Komodo 8120, Semaphore SSH
• Servers → Mgmt: Semaphore → pve 22 / 8006
• Servers → Storage: Talos nodes → Unraid app ports (unraid_apps group)
• Servers → WAN: Talos workers → 1.1.1.1:53 (cert-manager)
• IoT → Servers: Traefik 80/443 · IoT → Storage: Plex 32400 + discovery
• User → Servers: Traefik 80/443 · User → IoT: any (casting)
• Core, Servers, Storage, IoT, User → Gateway: UCG admin ports and resolver blocked
• IPS (blocking) on every network but STORAGE · Internal and Dmz: predefined, empty
